methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Climate & Energy (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 9 same-sector peers exist in Climate & Energy, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Fervo Energy is a Climate & Energy sector company at the IPO stage, having raised $1.5B+ to date. The comparable universe for advanced energy technology is limited: nine public and private peers identified within Climate & Energy, including one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private firms such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the peer set lacks sufficient clustering by stage and valuation tier to support conventional peer-median analysis.

The Peer-Median method is inapplicable due to insufficient narrow peer cohesion. No same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier subsets yielded the minimum three datapoints required for reliable triangulation. A broader sector-wide median would introduce material noise and obscure the company's specific risk and growth profile relative to its true comparables. The single public comparable provides limited directional color but insufficient basis for standalone valuation.

This analysis cannot produce a supported valuation range without additional method applicability—such as precedent transaction analysis, DCF framework, or revenue multiple frameworks tied to disclosed or inferred financial metrics. The key uncertainty remains the absence of a tight peer cluster; Fervo's geothermal technology positioning and capital intensity may diverge meaningfully from the broader Climate & Energy set. Any valuation recommendation requires either expansion of comparable data, disclosure of Fervo's financial metrics, or application of alternative methodologies.
